definitions.photon_kinematic_acceptance: pT>25 GeV, |eta|<2.37 excluding 1.37-1.52 crack, no tight-ID/iso requirement
definitions.hadronic_selection: 0 selected e/mu, >=3 selected jets (pT>25 GeV), >=1 b-tagged jet (jet_btag_quantile>=4)
definitions.leptonic_bookkeeping_selection: >=1 selected e/mu (pT>10 GeV, no ID/iso) AND >=1 b-tagged jet; bookkeeping only, not part of the required hadronic categorization
